task_summary: Transformed Academic Excel Gantt Chart into an interactive spreadsheet canvas: fillable timeline matrix cells across 60 days with click-to-toggle and drag-to-paint capabilities; 8-color theme palette in the paint toolbar with custom day shading; dynamic team member resolution extracting leader and members (e.g. Solo Leveling with Megumi Josh Fushiguro) with fallback to canonical proponents; fixed member filter from All Members (32) to true member count; inline editable DAYS and % DONE columns recalculating dates and progress; row addition and deletion with trash icon action column; removed redundant outer modals and consolidated direct spreadsheet actions; verified with 13/13 unit tests, 0 route mismatches, 60/60 agentic validation checks, and 4-way Playwright visual audit across desktop and mobile in light and dark modes.
